title: First-party Command Work Queue read-only six-system-view projection
goal: Implement an independently authorized one-tenant/one-environment Incident/Task projection for all six canonical Command system views, before shared Saved Views/pagination/production adapters.
invariants: Exactly six Command system view keys: all, incidents, tasks, unassigned, sla-risk, my-work; no route per view or legacy Team Load.
Only Command Incident and Task owner data; linked Case/Decision/Run identities are excluded rather than permission-cloned.
Mandatory exact tenant and environment plus current host-side authorization per individual object before projecting fields; no client access boolean.
This slice owns no Shared Saved View persistence/versions, incident/task mutation, assignment, export, production IAM, provider or UI.
security_properties: Missing/wildcard/invalid scope and unknown view fail before any owner read.
Foreign tenant/environment owner rows not reauthorized or rendered; denied object and provider failure yield zero privileged rows.
Unresolved SLA policy state is partial and never silently treated as safe.
At most 5000 provider candidates, 50 first-page rows with deterministic timestamp sorting; no unbounded projection.

migration.rationale: New independent read-only first-party Go module with no existing persisted data

rollback.strategy: Do not use the new Command projection module; all existing Investigate runtimes and main remain unchanged
verification: All ancestor draft PR SHAs unchanged

inputs: Canonical CAP-CMD-101 full specification §§1-27 and Command Saved Views catalogue
Canonical Incident/Task owner distinction, tenant and permission contracts

outputs: Dependency-free first-party Go projection accepting a host Owner List+CanRead interface for Incident/Task
Six system keys on one projection, stable ordering and bounded first-page results; no API/GUI
Negative tests foreign tenant, denied object, invalid view/scope, provider errors, incomplete/duplicate data, unknown SLA
Unique architecture path registration, security-critical scope registration and exact HEAD GitHub Go CI
Explicit handoff distinguishing isolated tested slice from canonical product completion
On-demand real Command Work Queue benchmark with explicit Go probe, existing benchmark runner and unchanged 90% security floor.
Security test evidence adapter reuses real bounded Go module tests, no invented security PASS before exact-head CI.
acceptance_tests: Each of six views resolves correct owner-authorized Incident/Task IDs, and hidden foreign/denied IDs never appear.
Unknown view including deprecated team-load, missing tenant/env/principal, bad owner metadata and authorization backend errors fail closed.
SLA risk without authoritative policy is partial-sources, not complete; first page <=50 is deterministic.
GitHub command-work-queue workflow succeeds on Linux, Windows, macOS; engineering-kernel required checks on exact SHA, mandatory 90% changed-security coverage unchanged.
No assignment, export, Task/Incident mutation, Saved View storage or product acceptance claim.

performance_budget.rationale: In-memory owner list bounded at 5000 and first page 50, deterministic sort; no production latency SLO or repository adapter measured
metrics: At most 5000 candidate owner rows and 50 projected rows
O(n log n) bound sorting of permitted candidates, no unbounded backend loops
